request.text:
Ingenuity completes historic helicopter flight on Mars

The helicopter operated autonomously using onboard navigation and control software. NASA’s Perseverance rover recorded the flight and helped transmit information to Earth. The experiment demonstrated that an aircraft could achieve powered, controlled flight in the thin Martian atmosphere. Ingenuity was a technology demonstration designed to explore possibilities for future aerial exploration.
